parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Monthly planning horizon for the single-period transportation planning model

parameters.name: num_supply_nodes
parameters.description: Number of supply nodes in the coal shipping network

parameters.name: num_demand_nodes
parameters.description: Number of demand nodes in the coal shipping network

parameters.name: supply_availability
parameters.description: Available coal quantity at each supply node

parameters.name: demand_requirements
parameters.description: Required coal quantity at each demand node

parameters.name: distance_matrix
parameters.description: Transportation distance in kilometers from each supply node to each demand node

variables.name: shipment_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of coal shipped from each supply node to each demand node

variables.name: total_transportation_burden
variables.description: Total transportation burden measured in ton-kilometers

constraints.name: supply_limit
constraints.description: Total shipments out of each supply node must not exceed available supply

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: Each demand node must receive enough coal to satisfy demand requirements

constraints.name: balanced_network_exact_matching
constraints.description: In a balanced network, total supply and total demand are matched exactly by the shipment plan
constraints.formula: \sum_{j=1}^{N} x_{ij} = s_i \quad \forall i\in\mathcal{I},\qquad \sum_{i=1}^{M} x_{ij} = d_j \quad \forall j\in\mathcal{J}

constraints.name: variable_domain_continuous_burden
constraints.description: Total transportation burden is a continuous variable

objectives.name: transportation_burden_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total ton-kilometers associated with the shipment plan

objectives.name: feasibility_shipment_plan
objectives.description: Find any shipment plan satisfying all supply and demand requirements while respecting nonnegativity

final_objective.description: Minimize the total ton-kilometers associated with the shipment plan; the feasibility requirement is enforced through constraints, and the previous maximize sense is corrected to minimize.
